answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a time-locked stake ledger: every agent identity must lock capital that only the calendar can release. A payout stream behaves like a narrow inlet, letting work rewards trickle out slowly while one hundred fresh wallets each demand a full lockup. Each account also leaves a pigment, a reputation trace peers can inspect, so a farm of duplicates looks flat and young. Faking ten thousand agents means funding ten thousand forfeitures to win one vote, a cost that rises like a dune under a census.
